situation.zh: 你攒到了一点钱,想在市场买够吃两天的东西,但钱只够买一样。摊主可以帮你挑。
situation.en: You have saved a little money and want enough food for two days, but it is only enough for one item. The seller can help you choose.

npc.persona: A market seller who weighs things out. Honest, gives real advice when asked.
npc.greeting: Everything here is fresh today. How much do you need?

hit: Two days on that money? Then take the rice. It fills you longer.
I see. Half a bag of rice, and I will add some beans.
partial: Rice, yes. How much do you want?
For how long do you need it? Tell me again?
miss: I did not catch that. One more time?

slots.zh_hint: 说明你要多少 / 要吃多久
说明你的限制,让对方能替你权衡

reference_answer: I only have a little money. What can I buy that lasts two days?

provenance.rationale: 买菜时说清「要多少、预算多少、请你帮我挑」是成人每周都在做的事,也是三槽位表达的自然落点:物品 + 数量 + 限制。青年级在此第一次要求学习者同时传达数量与约束条件,而不只是需求本身。
provenance.frequency_basis: 需求金字塔第 1 层;day#85 / cheapest#1095 / bag#1252 在 NGSL 前 1,300,但 bread#2262 与 rice#2695 落在第三千段,beans 不在 NGSL 内 —— 主食名反而是最低频的一类,原措辞「全在中低频段」不成立;新增的是数量与限制表达,现实购物对话里出现频率极高。
